# Boot rules

`validateBoot` reports every violation as `- [<id>] <message>`, followed by a `Fix:` and a `Rule:` line that links the entry below. Violations with an `unclassified/<check>` id have no entry yet. `kumiko-schema validate --json` returns the same ids.

## api

| Rule | Summary | Fix | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="api-provider-not-mounted"></a>`api/provider-not-mounted` | The feature exposing a used API is part of the app's feature list. | Register the provider feature in the app's feature list. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/api-ext-rules.ts` |
| <a id="api-provider-not-required"></a>`api/provider-not-required` | A feature using an API lists the exposing feature in requires or optionalRequires. | Add the exposing feature via r.requires({ features: [...] }). | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/api-ext-rules.ts` |
| <a id="api-unknown-api"></a>`api/unknown-api` | Every r.usesApi name is exposed by some mounted feature. | Mount the feature that exposes the API or fix the API name. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/api-ext-rules.ts` |

## boot-check

| Rule | Summary | Fix | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="boot-check-failed"></a>`boot-check/failed` | A feature's r.bootCheck invariant holds for the mounted feature set. | Satisfy the invariant named in the message or unmount the feature that declares it. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/boot-check-rules.ts` |

## entity-list

| Rule | Summary | Fix | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="entity-list-default-sort-not-listed"></a>`entity-list/default-sort-not-listed` | defaultSort.field is one of the listed columns. | Pick a field from columns or add it there. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/entity-list-screens-rules.ts` |
| <a id="entity-list-default-sort-not-sortable"></a>`entity-list/default-sort-not-sortable` | The defaultSort column is sortable. | Mark the field sortable or pick another defaultSort field. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/entity-list-screens-rules.ts` |
| <a id="entity-list-default-sort-required"></a>`entity-list/default-sort-required` | A list with active search or filterable fields declares a defaultSort. | Set defaultSort: { field, direction } on the screen. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/entity-list-screens-rules.ts` |
| <a id="entity-list-detail-without-navigate"></a>`entity-list/detail-without-navigate` | A list whose entity has a detail screen offers a navigate row action. | Add a navigate rowAction with id "view" or "edit". | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/entity-list-screens-rules.ts` |
| <a id="entity-list-searchable-false"></a>`entity-list/searchable-false` | Operator lists are searchable unless they are on the searchable-false whitelist. | Set searchable: true or add the screen id to the whitelist. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/entity-list-screens-rules.ts` |
| <a id="entity-list-unknown-column"></a>`entity-list/unknown-column` | Every column without a label names an entity field, derived field or row-meta column. | Fix the column field name or give the column a label. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/entity-list-screens-rules.ts` |
| <a id="entity-list-unknown-named-filter"></a>`entity-list/unknown-named-filter` | Every screen namedFilters id is declared in the entity's namedFilters. | Declare the rule in EntityDefinition.namedFilters or remove the id from the screen. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/entity-list-screens-rules.ts` |

## extension

| <a id="extension-provider-not-required"></a>`extension/provider-not-required` | A feature using an extension lists the defining feature in requires or optionalRequires. | Add the defining feature via r.requires({ features: [...] }). | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/api-ext-rules.ts` |

## i18n

| Rule | Summary | Fix | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="i18n-locale-inconsistent"></a>`i18n/locale-inconsistent` | Every locale a feature uses is maintained for every one of its translation keys. | Add the missing locale to the key, or move that locale into a locale package. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/i18n-keys-rules.ts` |
| <a id="i18n-missing-feature-key"></a>`i18n/missing-feature-key` | Every translation key a feature surface requires is defined. | Add the key via r.translations(...) in the feature. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/i18n-keys-rules.ts` |
| <a id="i18n-missing-field-value-translation"></a>`i18n/missing-field-value-translation` | With requireFieldValueTranslations, select options and embedded cells are translated. | Add the keys via r.translations(...) in the owning feature. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/i18n-keys-rules.ts` |
| <a id="i18n-missing-required-locale"></a>`i18n/missing-required-locale` | Every translation key exists in every locale the app requires. | Load the matching locale package or add the missing translations. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/i18n-keys-rules.ts` |
| <a id="i18n-missing-settings-hub-key"></a>`i18n/missing-settings-hub-key` | Every translation key the generated settings hub requires is defined. | Add the key via r.translations(...) in the owning feature. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/i18n-keys-rules.ts` |

## named-filter

| Rule | Summary | Fix | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="named-filter-projection-query-accepts-named-filter"></a>`named-filter/projection-query-accepts-named-filter` | A projectionList with namedFilters binds a query whose schema has a namedFilter key. | Add namedFilter: z.string().optional() to the query schema, resolve it with resolveNamedListFilters and pass the conditions into executor.list filters, the only path that applies field-read and PII guards. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/named-filter-rules.ts` |
| <a id="named-filter-stat-navigate-filter-declared"></a>`named-filter/stat-navigate-filter-declared` | A stat navigate.namedFilter is declared in the target screen's namedFilters. | Add { id, label } to namedFilters of the target screen. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/named-filter-rules.ts` |
| <a id="named-filter-stat-navigate-same-named-filter"></a>`named-filter/stat-navigate-same-named-filter` | A stat's params.namedFilter equals navigate.namedFilter. | Set params.namedFilter to the same id as navigate.namedFilter. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/named-filter-rules.ts` |
| <a id="named-filter-stat-navigate-same-query"></a>`named-filter/stat-navigate-same-query` | A stat with navigate counts with the target list's own query. | Set the stat query to the target list's query. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/named-filter-rules.ts` |
| <a id="named-filter-stat-navigate-static-filter"></a>`named-filter/stat-navigate-static-filter` | A stat repeats the target screen's static filter in params.filter. | Set params.filter to the target screen's filter. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/named-filter-rules.ts` |
| <a id="named-filter-stat-navigate-target"></a>`named-filter/stat-navigate-target` | A stat navigate.screen resolves to an entityList or projectionList screen. | Point navigate.screen at a registered list screen. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/named-filter-rules.ts` |

## pii

| Rule | Summary | Fix | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="pii-lookupable-non-text"></a>`pii/lookupable-non-text` | Blind-index lookups apply to text fields only. | Use a text field or set find: "none". | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-lookupable-without-subject"></a>`pii/lookupable-without-subject` | A blind-index lookup requires a subject annotation on the field. | Add a personal annotation or set find: "none". | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-multiple-subject-annotations"></a>`pii/multiple-subject-annotations` | A field carries at most one subject-key annotation. | Keep a single personal annotation on the field. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-jsonb-custom-fields"></a>`pii/personal-jsonb-custom-fields` | The custom-fields jsonb column cannot carry a personal annotation. | Drop the personal annotation. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-jsonb-flag"></a>`pii/personal-jsonb-flag` | A personal jsonb field cannot be sortable, filterable, searchable or lookupable, its value is a ciphertext string. | Remove the flag or the personal annotation. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-jsonb-index"></a>`pii/personal-jsonb-index` | A personal jsonb field is not part of an entity index. | Drop the index or the personal annotation. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-of-invalid-when-absent"></a>`pii/personal-of-invalid-when-absent` | personal.whenAbsent is either "tenant" or "self". | Remove whenAbsent or set it to "tenant" or "self". | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-of-missing-owner-name"></a>`pii/personal-of-missing-owner-name` | personal: { of } names the owner field. | Pass the name of the owner field: personal: { of: "<ownerField>" }. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-of-optional-owner"></a>`pii/personal-of-optional-owner` | An optional owner field of personal: { of } declares a whenAbsent fallback. | Set whenAbsent to "tenant" or "self", or make the owner field required. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-of-owner-type"></a>`pii/personal-of-owner-type` | The owner field named by personal: { of } is a reference or text field. | Use a reference or text field as owner. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-of-unknown-owner"></a>`pii/personal-of-unknown-owner` | The owner field named by personal: { of } exists on the entity. | Point personal.of at an existing field of the entity. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-plaintext-user-reference"></a>`pii/plaintext-user-reference` | A reference to the user entity is never plaintext. | Use the default reference field or personal: "ref" instead of personal: false. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-sensitive-searchable"></a>`pii/sensitive-searchable` | A sensitive field is never searchable. | Drop searchable, or add writeOnly to never return the value. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-sensitive-without-ciphertext"></a>`pii/sensitive-without-ciphertext` | A sensitive field is stored as ciphertext at rest. | Add a subject annotation or encrypted: true. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-subject-key-sortable"></a>`pii/subject-key-sortable` | A field with a subject-key annotation is not sortable, its column is ciphertext. | Drop sortable, use find: "exact" for equality lookups, or keep the field plaintext. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-text-without-personal-stance"></a>`pii/text-without-personal-stance` | Every text and longText field declares whether it holds personal data. | Declare a personal stance, or personal: false with a reason stating why the value is not personal data. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-write-only-conflicting-flag"></a>`pii/write-only-conflicting-flag` | A writeOnly field cannot be defaulted, searched, sorted, filtered or looked up. | Remove either writeOnly or the conflicting flag. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-write-only-embedded-sub-field"></a>`pii/write-only-embedded-sub-field` | writeOnly is only supported on top-level text fields, not on embedded sub-fields. | Remove writeOnly from the sub-field or declare it on a top-level text field. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-write-only-non-text"></a>`pii/write-only-non-text` | writeOnly applies to text fields only. | Use a text field or remove writeOnly. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-write-only-without-sensitive"></a>`pii/write-only-without-sensitive` | A writeOnly field is also sensitive. | Declare the field with find: "secret". | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |

## user-data-rights

| Rule | Summary | Fix | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="user-data-rights-empty-hook"></a>`user-data-rights/empty-hook` | An EXT_USER_DATA registration declares at least one of an export or a delete hook. | Register at least one hook. | `packages/bundled-features/src/user-data-rights/boot-rules.ts` |
